evidence.observation: 2.952 Torr at growth start, in line with the ramp baseline of about 2.96
3.159 Torr; rose every reading (2.995, 3.017, 3.075, 3.119), about 0.04 Torr per 120 s
Flow steady at about 100 sccm, matching setpoint, so the rise is not from extra gas input
Temperature holds at 750 °C and heater power is steady; thermal control looks normal
O2 sensor not installed, so we can't check whether air is getting into the tube

args.missing_evidence: Something that tells a seal leak (air getting in, which would show up as O2) apart from an exhaust or pump restriction: an exhaust O2 or residual-gas reading, a leak-up test with the tube isolated, or a check of the exhaust/pump-side pressure and valve position. No ref values were given for this run.
